name: awesome-claude-plugins
description: A curated collection of Claude Code plugins for local Claude Code workflows.

plugins.name: roast-my-code
plugins.description: Get your code brutally roasted by hilarious personas — Gordon Ramsay, Shakespeare, a passive-aggressive therapist, and more. Real code review value wrapped in entertainment.

plugins.name: mockdown
plugins.description: Generate ASCII wireframes from UI descriptions. Describe your UI in plain English or point to a PRD, and get a terminal-friendly wireframe mockup.

plugins.name: tree-ring-memory
plugins.description: Local-first memory lifecycle guidance for Claude Code: recall, evidence-backed capture, audit, consolidation, redaction, and forgetting.
